name: Translate to Hungarian
description: A voice speaks what you say in Hungarian. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 131 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Hungarian model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice hu_HU-anna-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, CC0.
